input_boundary: Extracted atomic facts and oracle candidate memories are supplied directly. Extraction and retrieval are not evaluated here.
description: Development cases for batched, fact-scoped memory reconciliation. This dataset may guide prompt and model changes and is not an untouched holdout.

notes: Every expected decision is aligned to its fact_index.
Target correctness is scored using stable candidate IDs, not indices across facts.
Generated UPDATE wording is checked with deterministic content assertions rather than exact text.
Confidence and explanations are not compared exactly.

cases.description: Two unrelated durable facts must both be created without being merged.

fact.content: The user prefers direct feedback.
fact.evidence: I prefer direct feedback

fact.content: The user wants to learn Japanese.
fact.evidence: I want to learn Japanese

cases.description: Ending one goal must not suppress creation of an unrelated preference.

fact.content: The user no longer wants to open a bakery.
fact.evidence: I gave up opening a bakery

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to open a bakery.
The user avoids asking for feedback.

fact.content: The user prefers receiving feedback face to face.
fact.evidence: I prefer feedback face to face

cases.description: A location replacement and a new goal require independent actions.

fact.content: The user now lives in Berlin.
fact.evidence: I now live in Berlin

candidate_memories.content: The user lives in Munich.
The user enjoys visiting large cities.

fact.content: The user wants to run a half marathon.
fact.evidence: I want to run a half marathon

cases.description: An already represented fact is NOOP while a distinct fact is created.

fact.content: The user values autonomy at work.
fact.evidence: Autonomy at work matters deeply to me

candidate_memories.content: The user values autonomy in their career.

fact.content: The user decided to accept the product lead role.
fact.evidence: I accepted the product lead role

cases.description: An abandoned goal must invalidate the matching goal, not a same-type distractor.

fact.content: The user no longer plans to learn piano.
fact.evidence: Piano is no longer a goal

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to become confident speaking in public.
The user wants to learn piano.

cases.description: An unmatched invalidation is NOOP and must not interfere with another creation.

fact.content: The user no longer wants to learn piano.
fact.evidence: I stopped wanting to learn piano

candidate_memories.content: The user tends to avoid asking for feedback.

fact.content: The user wants to improve their sleep routine.
fact.evidence: I want to improve my sleep routine

cases.description: Paraphrased duplicate extracted facts may produce only one CREATE.

fact.content: The user wants to learn Japanese.
fact.evidence: I want to learn Japanese

fact.content: Learning Japanese is a goal for the user.
fact.evidence: learning Japanese is my goal

cases.description: Local candidate indices must not leak between two independent updates.

fact.content: The user now prefers a quick call for work feedback.
fact.evidence: I now prefer a quick call for work feedback

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers written work feedback.
The user prefers vegetarian meals.

fact.content: The user now prefers vegan meals.
fact.evidence: I now prefer vegan meals

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers morning meetings.
The user prefers vegetarian meals.

cases.description: Two overlapping facts must not independently rewrite the same snapshot target.

fact.content: The user prefers remote work.
fact.evidence: I prefer remote work

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers office work.

fact.content: The user prefers working from home.
fact.evidence: working from home is what I prefer

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers office work.

cases.description: Separate sibling and coworker relationships must remain separate creations.

fact.content: Nadia is the user's sister.
fact.evidence: Nadia is my sister

fact.content: The user works with Nadia.
fact.evidence: Nadia and I work together

cases.description: Topical similarity alone must not mutate or create duplicates.

fact.content: The user wants to learn Japanese.
fact.evidence: I want to learn Japanese

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to improve their Spanish.

fact.content: The user values honest communication.
fact.evidence: I value honest communication

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers direct feedback.

cases.description: Replacement content must preserve scope and remove the contradicted value.

fact.content: The user now wants to speak confidently specifically in work meetings.
fact.evidence: I now want to speak confidently in work meetings

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to become comfortable speaking in public.

cases.description: Two invalidations must select their own matching targets among distractors.

fact.content: The user is no longer vegetarian.
fact.evidence: I am no longer vegetarian

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers working in the morning.
The user follows a vegetarian diet.

fact.content: The user no longer plans to move to Paris.
fact.evidence: I no longer plan to move to Paris

candidate_memories.content: The user plans to move to Paris.
The user wants to learn Japanese.

cases.description: One compound batch contains CREATE, UPDATE, INVALIDATE, and NOOP without cross-fact leakage.

fact.content: The user wants to start strength training.
fact.evidence: I want to start strength training

fact.content: The user now lives in Lisbon.
fact.evidence: I now live in Lisbon

candidate_memories.content: The user lives in Porto.

fact.content: The user no longer wants to write a novel.
fact.evidence: I no longer want to write a novel

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to write a novel.

fact.content: The user prefers concise answers.
fact.evidence: I still prefer concise answers

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers concise answers.

cases.description: An invalidation with no matching candidate must be NOOP, never CREATE.

fact.content: The user no longer wants to become a pilot.
fact.evidence: I no longer want to become a pilot

cases.description: Commitment wording and adjacent taxonomy do not justify rewriting the same active proposition.

fact.content: The user has decided to save for a home deposit.
fact.evidence: I decided to start saving for a home deposit

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to save money for a home deposit.

cases.description: A new value must be created when the supplied candidate is only topically related.

fact.content: The user values making information accessible to everyone.
fact.evidence: Making information accessible to everyone matters to me

candidate_memories.content: The user prefers concise written explanations.

cases.description: A new family relationship must be created when an unrelated relationship with the same person exists.

fact.content: Priya is the user's sister-in-law.
fact.evidence: Priya is my sister-in-law

candidate_memories.content: The user volunteers with Priya.
